# TokenVector.Numerics

> High-performance tensor computing, linear algebra, autograd, optimization, signal processing, quantum, astrodynamics, finance, and computational physics library for .NET 8 — published natively in the **TokenVector language** standard library (`.tkv`, spec TV-1001) with full numeric-surface coverage (354/354 audited functions).

TokenVector.Numerics is the numerics runtime of the [TokenVector](https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector) language ecosystem. Version 1.1.1 (September 25, 2026), MIT license, .NET 8 LTS, NuGet package `TokenVector.Numerics`. v1.1.1 is a documentation-and-correctness release: the `TokenVector.Numerics.dll` is byte-identical to v1.1.0 (the C# engine sources were removed in v1.1.0, so the assembly is no longer recompilable from source).

## Language Specification

- [TokenVector Syntax Spec (English)](TOKENVECTOR_SYNTAX_SPEC.md): formal TV-1001 grammar — `import tv`, `from tv.core import from_array`, `tv.linalg`, `tv.autograd`, `tv.neural`, `tv.optimize`; compile with `tkvc build main.tkv --out app.exe` (`build` is the only subcommand; there is no `-r`/`-o` flag)
- [TokenVector Syntax Spec (Tiếng Việt)](TOKENVECTOR_SYNTAX_SPEC_VI.md): bản tiếng Việt của đặc tả ngữ pháp

## TokenVector Standard Library (.tkv)

- [Stdlib README](src/tokenvector/README.md): module map (27 `.tkv` modules ≈ 12.1k lines), TV-1001 translation conventions, coverage tables, benchmark tables
- Modules: `core`, `engine`, `io`, `linalg`, `linalg_functions`, `ops`, `manipulation`, `grid`, `compare`, `autograd`, `neural`, `optimize`, `interpolation`, `poly`, `special`, `fft`, `signal`, `random`, `statistics`, `quantum`, `physics`, `astro`, `finance`, `spatial`, `geometry3d`, `crypto_graph`, `biology_robotics`
- Each module header lists its per-section source mapping and fidelity notes (Parallel.For/AVX2 collapse to scalar loops; `tkvc -O parallel -O simd` restores them)

## Verification

Reproducible today (re-run September 25, 2026):

- [Exact-arithmetic mathlib](mathlib/): `bf_bigfloat.tkv` → **PASS 8/8**, `nt_number_theory.tkv` → **PASS 9/9**. Both are pure TokenVector with no `tv` import, so they build and run standalone: `tkvc build mathlib/bf_bigfloat.tkv --out bf.exe && ./bf.exe`. Fixes in this pass: Chudnovsky constant, `bignum_neg` limb loss, `pi_chudnovsky` precision/leading-zero, overflow-safe modular multiply/add, and `i64` boundary guards in `isqrt_i`/`trial_prime`/`factorize`/`iroot`.
- Source-level algorithm review: **36/36** across `linalg`, `linalg_functions`, `fft`, `crypto_graph` (complex arithmetic, matrix algebra incl. Cholesky A=LLᵀ, FFT vs an independent DFT oracle for N=1,2,4,5,6,7,8,9, NTT round-trip and graph Laplacian). This is a source review against independent oracles, **not** a native execution.

Not currently reproducible — known limitation:

- [Smoke suite](tests/tokenvector/smoke_tests.tkv): the documented `tkvc build tests/tokenvector/smoke_tests.tkv --entry main --out smoke.exe` **fails** on current `tkvc` builds with `File khong co ham top-level nao co annotation kieu DSL`. Root cause: `tkvc build` resolves `import tv` against its own bundled directory and exposes no runtime-path flag (the `-r src/tokenvector` form in the file header is rejected). The **175/175** figure is therefore the **v1.1.0 release record**, not a live gate. CI runs the two `mathlib` suites instead (`verify-mathlib`); the smoke suite is excluded until stdlib resolution is fixed.

Other evidence:

- Coverage audit: stdlib surface vs an independent numeric-library reference (354 library functions audited) — matched=354 (100%), missing=0
- Benchmark (measured for v1.1.0): compiled-TokenVector kernels (via `tkvc.exe build bench_test.tkv`, one kernel per exe) vs NumPy 2.5.2 on the same machine — parity: matmul/add checksums to float64 limits, SVD 2.4e-14, FFT ~1e-12; ratios: add ~7x, FFT radix-2 ~17x, matmul 365–1308x, SVD ~1880x (compiled, not interpreted)
- Runtime release record: 84/84 unit tests passed at v1.1.0 (run log in TEST_REPORT.md; shipped binaries in dist/bin/)
